notes.title: Patch Notes | 16.09.2025
notes.content:
Fixes

General:
Improvements to AI behaviour to both enemy and story characters.

Various animation fixes and enhancements.

Amendments and improvements to the game’s UI and inventory screens.

Numerous texture improvements throughout.

Fixes to lead tracking where required.

Reduced character, weapon, item and AI clipping against environments.

Kicks will now cause the expected flinch reaction on a successful hit.

Improved dialogue timing and flow.

Quest notifications will no longer appear repeatedly at the top left of the screen every time the game is unpaused.

The Club, Mace, Police Truncheon, Cricket Bat, and Spiked Club will now generate blood VFX when striking enemies.

Spore Mines are now correctly detected by Prescience or Attunement abilities before unfurling.

Blood splatters are now correctly generated on enemies or bodies when hit or shot.

Scrolling through a trader's inventory will now no longer incorrectly skip from item 1 to item 6.

The map will no longer refresh unnecessarily when selecting a different region.

The 'Unequip' option will now function as expected when selecting 'More Options' on the Torch, Metal Detector, or Signal Redirector.
Quest Specific Fixes:
Fixed an issue where ending cutscenes for Joyce Tanner and the Wicked Isle Poison Abbot Head would not trigger on PS4.

The Exfil Camp will no longer become hostile while the "Escape with Captain Sims" objective is active.

When received from Bill Anderson, the Lee No.4 can no longer be upgraded more than once in the player’s backpack.

Fixed an issue where important items, such as the flask in Wicked Isle, could disappear if there wasn’t enough inventory space at the time of acquisition.

The player can now progress as expected after dropping the offering given by Mother Jago for the Speaking Cave.

After Bill Anderson drinks the flask and becomes Prior Ignatius, his name will no longer incorrectly display as “Bill Anderson” when highlighted.
Location Specific Fixes:

Slatten Dales
A torch can no longer be seen floating in the Slate Mine Caves.
Wyndham Village
Using the Decomposition skill on AI in the Village will no longer result in villagers becoming hostile.

Villagers will no longer become hostile after the player kills Billy Gorse.
Casterfell Woods
An Atomic Battery is now no longer placed incorrectly within a wall in Casterfell Woods, preventing the High Priestess to walk through the wall to interact with it.

A Storage Junction Box is now no longer missing in the data storage area of the Dam in Casterfell Woods.
Windscale Plant
Thrall will now follow the player as expected from the broken platform near the hammer plant in the control room of the Windscale Plant.
Midsummer Isle (Wicked Isle Story Expansion)
A fuel cannister is no longer misaligned and floating above the ground near a rack in the Flooded Cellar.

Fire VFX is now present in the bonfire located in the camp at the crossing area to the Chemical Testing Bunker.

The player will no longer fall through the map after boarding the boat on Midsummer Isle to return to Wyndham Village.

The player can no longer kill a Feral through a closed glass door using a melee weapon in the Chemical Testing Bunker.

Grove Druids will now approach the player as expected when entering the wooden tent after combat engagement near the rear entrance of the Abbey’s broken building.

notes.title: Patch Notes | 03.06.2025

 Button icons now appear correctly when using a Steam Controller
 The melee weapon aim tracker now adjusts correctly when switching to a crouched position
 Rifle ammunition stock now replenishes for Molly and Bootsy when they restock
 Player can no longer trigger a slide when there was not enough room to do so to ensure it is more difficult to walk off edges
 The toggle for the “Hold” option will affect direct recipe clicks in the crafting menu as intended
 Added ‘Hide Crosshair’ option to remove the crosshair and hit markers from the HUD
 General stability and performance improvements
 Improvements to game and menu UI
 Animation fixes and enhancements
 Lighting and texture improvements 
 Improvements to localisation and translations 


Location Specific Fixes
Slatten Dales

 NPCs in cleared camps will no longer respawn after reloading a save
 Enemies no longer get stuck on the ramp near the entrance to the Waterwheels 


Wyndham Village

 Fixed an issue where, in certain circumstances, players could become stuck near the truck on the road to the Band Stand in Wyndham Village
 Fixed a crash that could occur after leaving the Bakery in Wyndham Village
 Protocol Soldiers will no longer shoot the water when they detect leeches


Casterfell Woods

 Improved AI behaviours 
 Wasps will now spawn from the nest as intended after the player transitions out/ into the woods
 The plant near the pond in the garage will trigger as intended 


Skethermoor

 Two wooden posts have been separated to avoid clipping inside the Feed Mill 
 Fixed an issue where Outlaws could fire from unintended positions


Interchange

 The second plant mine in Data Store Alpha in the Interchange will now open without the player needing to be extremely close
 The glass on the MOD entrance control room is now the same on both sides


Lead Specific Fixes (potential spoilers)


 Dr Garrow will no longer become hostile and attack the player if they shoot Dr Holder to save her in the Interchange control room
 Joyce Tanner will now appear correctly when finishing her quest
 The map location will update correctly to reflect the convoy crash site
 Fixed an issue where the Batteries Not Included achievement would not unlock 
 The scientist from the beginning of the game no longer incorrectly reappears during the Mystery Voice’s ending
 Fixed an issue where Mother Jago would request her book again even after already receiving it in a previous exchange

notes.title: Patch Notes | 27.03.2025
notes.content:
ATOMFALL DAY 1 UPDATE FIXES
In addition to general bug fixing and gameplay improvements the latest title update to Atomfall addresses the following issues:

Global

 Fixed an overlapping issue in subtitles, playstyle warning messages, and barter screens 
 Fixed an issue where in some circumstance the AI would not escalate to combat 
 Fixed an issue with NPCs (such as Molly, Joyce) getting hostile with you after attacking them once and conversing continuously with them during gameplay
 Fixed an issue where Throwable weapons could clip through the metal barricades 
 Fixed an issue with Spits from ferals not generating a PFX, making it hard to see their trajectory
 Fixed issues where the alarm audio did not stop on exfil 
 Fixed an issue where multiple characters could turn hostile when the player used tools nearby
 Saves from different game versions are now able to be loaded
 Improved how AI populates when loading an autosave
 Player ammo and trader material counts now appear correctly after bartering
 Fixed an issue where the outro fails to trigger after closing the backpack opened before the end of the conversation and after selecting the escape option during gameplay
 Fixed a cutoff issue in tooltip bar relating to some Russian characters in the menu
 Fixed where item name and description could remain on screen after picking item up in Backpack 
 Fixed an issue where the ‘Save game time’ text appeared too long
 Added translations for landmines 
 Updated text for Field Time User Setup and Field of View slider


Slatten Dales

 Improved the effect of the torch in shadowed areas of Slatten Dales 


Wyndham Village

 Fixed an issue where the player failed to progress the quest 'Sims wants me question Dr Garrow' if they retrieved the information from Dr Garrow before receiving the quest


Casterfell Woods

 Reduced character clipping through the platform while getting down from the platform near wooden logs in Casterfell Woods
 Improved takedown animation when crouching
 Fixed a collision issue on the rock present near the broken building in the Old Watermill in Casterfell Woods
 Updated lighting to make it easier to find Mother Jago's book in the castle
 Fixed progression issue when the player fails to progress through the quest on interacting with Mother Jago after picking up the Growth Serum and the book of Herbalism during the gameplay 
 Fixed an issue with Druids and Mother Jago appearing hostile towards the player character on entering the Castle Ruins for exfil during gameplay if you antagonised them previously


Skethermoor

 Fixed a crash on PS4 which occurred when players idle in Skethermore for too long 


Interchange

 Power on and power up sound in Radio Tower and Robotics Lab now fixed


Please continue to send us your bug reports. Including screenshots, video clips and full descriptions of the issues you might encounter will be hugely beneficial. Our Player Support portal is here.

notes.title: Can You Survive The Quarantine Zone? Atomfall® Is Available Now
notes.content:
We are pleased to share that Atomfall® has launched today. The game is available to play now. Atomfall® is also Certified on Steam Deck.

The new Atomfall® Accolades Trailer is available here

[previewyoutube=VujGY4MW0a8;full][/previewyoutube]

A UK-based post-apocalyptic survival-action game, Atomfall® is inspired by the real life Windscale nuclear incident in the 1950s. Players will embark on a fictionalised adventure meeting a cast of weird and wonderful characters as they try to uncover the mystery of what happened at the Atom Plant and escape the Quarantine Zone.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32806657/90504bb2437b7e92b551ea924226eccc47d2f7d2.jpg
The Editions:

Atomfall’s® Standard Edition is available digitally, as well as in a boxed physical edition for consoles published by Fireshine Games

Atomfall’s® Deluxe Edition is available digitally.  This Deluxe Edition gives players the Basic Supply Bundle DLC, that offers additional items and supplies to uncover as you explore, including an exclusive melee weapon variant, additional loot caches and an item recipe. It also gives players an Enhanced Supply Bundle, which includes an exclusive pistol variant, metal detector skin and character upgrades. Alongside this, players will also enjoy access to the Story Expansion Pack: Wicked Isle DLC when released*. Players who purchase the Standard Edition can purchase the Deluxe Upgrade to enjoy the same additional content.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32806657/31ccc0bd68aa5a534edfa1f68a94b90e6627e29a.jpg
Game Features:


 A single player survival-action game, drawing from science fiction, folk horror, and Cold War influences to create a world that is eerily familiar yet completely alien
 Uncover leads through investigation, exploration, conversation and combat as you attempt to solve a mystery inspired by classic British science fiction such as The Day of the Triffids, early Doctor Who, and The Quatermass Experiment
 Desperate high stakes combat blends expert marksmanship with vicious hand-to-hand combat
 Craft items and weapons that may save your life, ransack ruined houses for supplies, and even unearth hidden treasures using your trusty metal detector
 Define your character through interactions with NPCs, light RPG elements, and skill trees
 For the latest news and updates, please visit Atomfall.com and be sure to follow Atomfall® on our social channels: Twitter, Facebook, Instagram and YouTube.

* The Atomfall: Story Expansion Pack: Wicked Isle is not available Day 1

notes.title: New Atomfall® Trailer Showcases A World Of Danger And Mystery
notes.content:
Search, Scavenge, Survive

We are proud to share that we have a brand new trailer  for our forthcoming survival action game, Atomfall®. The new trailer showcases the game’s key features. Atomfall® is coming March 27th 2025 and is available to pre-order. 

The new Features trailer for Atomfall® is available to watch here: [previewyoutube=5k1QT6gM5wY;full][/previewyoutube]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32806657/b467b4b8a7afad41f7fd1157fe47e7545cd40995.png

Gamers who pre-order the Standard Edition of Atomfall® will receive the Basic Supply Bundle DLC which offers additional items and supplies to uncover as you explore. In addition to the Basic Supply Bundle DLC, the Deluxe Edition also gives players an Enhanced Supply Bundle, which includes an exclusive pistol variant, metal detector skin and a skill manual giving character upgrades, as well as 3 days early access. Players will also receive the Story Expansion DLC when released**.

Also available for PC players, exclusive to the Rebellion® Shop, is the Quarantine Edition which includes all rewards within the Deluxe Edition, as well as a host of additional content.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32806657/71739c10ae2da1e3ca1071ebf71b89720de2ff7f.jpg

Opening in an abandoned bunker 5 years after a nuclear disaster in Northern England the trailer shows how players enter the world of Atomfall®. In this scene an unnamed worker in a hazmat suit stumbles into your room and asks, ‘who are you?’ This question is just one of the mysteries that players will need to solve if you are to find out what happened at the Windscale atom plant.  

From here the trailer teases more of the settings and landscapes that players will need to explore as they get to grips with life inside the quarantine zone. This slice of Northern England includes everything from open moors, rugged hills, dense woodlands and the picture-perfect English village Wyndham. But beware, this is a dangerous and hostile landscape filled with gangs of outlaws, crazed cultists and unexplained horrors. Even the local wildlife poses an immense threat to your life. If you are to navigate this land and survive, you will need to fight for your life and scavenge resources.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32806657/c3206f85e1e6d856a140669e4356314687f2093e.jpg

Atomfall® is packed with a cast of quirky and eccentric characters that you will meet on your journey. These people have been isolated from the world for some time and while many have adopted a ‘keep calm and carry on’ mentality, some have sought to seize power and twisted events for their own gain. Others have even slipped into more nefarious ways… Your interactions with these characters will uncover various leads, secrets and story threads that will help you discover the truth of what happened during the Windscale disaster. But, needless to say, not everyone you meet means you well and deciding who to trust in the quarantine zone is a matter of life or death.

For the latest news and updates, please visit Atomfall.com and be sure to follow Atomfall® on our new social channels:  Twitter, Facebook, Instagram and YouTube.  

* Early unlock up to 3 days before the release date. Platform and dates availability subject to change

** Story Expansion not available Day 1

But be careful, they aren’t all friendly and you will need to get to grips with an array of ranged and melee weapons if you are to survive!

notes.title: Atomfall | Coming March 2025
notes.content:
The Mystery of Windscale 

Atomfallers, 

Didn't make it to cologne for Gamescom 2024? Don't worry, we've got you covered. 

Delve deeper into the foreboding world of Atomfall and the mystery of Windscale by watching the new trailer, unveiled at this year's Gamescom. 

[previewyoutube=-ni32Aw4p70;full][/previewyoutube]
Opening in the style of a classic 1950s news reel, this latest trailer offers a closer look at Atomfall’s setting in the North of England. Atomfall is inspired by the real-life events of the 1957 Windscale disaster and the story picks up five years later in a fictionalised quarantine zone that encompasses rolling countryside, valleys, caves and even a picturesque English village. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057216/5bc1cfd69d79f452126715f216e9b9332107fdf4.jpg
But this picture-perfect postcard setting is a hostile landscape that hides a dark mystery. To get to the bottom of what happened at Windscale, you will need to navigate military encampments, delve through abandoned bunkers below ground, and risk your life in Pagan ruins. Your trusty metal detector will also help you uncover a few secrets buried beneath the surface! 

Central to the dark mystery are the host of eccentric characters and cryptic organisations that inhabit the quarantine zone. These individuals have been cut off from the outside world for years and left to their own devices, so are anything but normal. Your interactions with them are important and will shape your journey. But be careful, they aren’t all friendly and you will need to get to grips with an array of ranged and melee weapons if you are to survive!

We're beyond excited to show you more about this brand new title in the coming months so stay tuned and, as always...observe protocol.
